Wan2.2 工作流程：图像到视频

该集合提供高度集中的 Wan2.2 工作流程，围绕 3 采样器通道系统构建，以实现卓越的运动和合成质量。每个工作流程都经过简化，以擅长完成一项特定任务，设计为一个干净的基础，您可以通过自定义修改轻松扩展。这些并不是万能的解决方案——它们优先考虑单一功能的掌握。

包括的关键工作流程：

  • 无限谈话：根据文本提示、图像参考生成逼真的口型同步视频，和音频输入。包括集成的语音隔离，可与背景音乐无缝集成。

    • V1.1：添加了包含所有模型链接的文本框

  • FFGO：First Frame 是视频内容定制的最佳选择：只需使用第一帧定义场景中所需的关键元素，FFGO 将确保这些项目在整个生成的视频中保持锁定。角色、道具、背景：一开始可见的一切都仍然是参考。

  • FFLF：第一帧最后一帧：通过使用两个关键图像来锚定该过程，实现对动画循环的精确控制：一个定义开始，另一个定义结束。这确保了一致的转换和可预测的结果。

  • 图像到视频：简单而强大的转换工具。输入单个图像，得到动态视频输出。非常适合快速动画。

所有工作流程的基本节点

  • 万视频包装器

  • JK节点

  • 视频助手套件

o.en:
Wan2.2 Workflows: Image-to-Video

This collection delivers highly focused Wan2.2 workflows, built around a 3-sampler pass system for superior motion and composition quality. Each workflow is streamlined to excel at one specific task, designed as a clean base you can easily expand upon with custom modifications. These aren't jack-of-all-trades solutions – they prioritize mastery of a single function.

Key Workflows Included:

  • Infinitetalk:Generate realistic lip-synced video from text prompts, image references,andaudio input. Includes integrated voice isolation for seamless integration with background music.

    • V1.1: added text box with links to all the models

  • FFGO: First Frame is the Place to Go for Video Content Customization:Simply define the key elements you want in your scene with the first frame and FFGO will ensure those items stay locked-in throughout the entire generated video. Characters, props, backgrounds: whatever is visible at the start remains a reference.

  • FFLF: First Frame Last Frame:Achieve precise control over animation loops by anchoring the process with two key images: one defining the start and another the end. This ensures consistent transitions and predictable results.

  • Image to Video:Simple, powerful conversion tool. Input a single image, get a dynamic video output. ideal for quick animations.

Base Nodes for all workflows

  • WanVideoWrapper

  • JKNodes

  • VideoHelperSuite
